reuse.why: Resolves each occurrence with the existing shared getDateWithWeekendRule (the same function getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template use) and builds the schedule with recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule.

duplication.why: No weekend logic is duplicated; only the build-schedule/try/captureBreadcrumb skeleton mirrors getUpcomingDates, which is idiomatic for handlers in this file.

placement.why: The handler sits beside schedule/get-upcoming-dates and is registered the same way; the WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS bound encodes knowledge of the weekend rule locally rather than next to getDateWithWeekendRule/DAILY_SCAN_WINDOW in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Weekend semantics stay in one shared function, so the handler follows future rule changes automatically; only the lookaround constant would need to track a change in maximum shift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange calls getDateWithWeekendRule for every occurrence.
